meta.title: PICTOS Index · Pictogram quality
meta.description: PICTOS Index is an instrument for evaluating the communicative quality of pictogram libraries.

a11y.brandHome: PICTOS Index, return to the home page
a11y.dimensions: The six dimensions of the index

home.title: Does this pictogram communicate well?
home.lead: PICTOS Index helps evaluate a complete library from six complementary perspectives: clarity, recognition, meaning, use, culture and cognitive accessibility.
home.privacy: The evaluation is stored in this browser and downloaded only when you choose.

how.title: How it works
how.loadBody: Use a file exported from PICTOS.net or try the sample library.
how.relationBody: A brief answer helps interpret the experience from which the evaluation is made.
how.evaluateBody: First record what it communicates; then review its six dimensions, one at a time, on a scale from 1 to 5.

principles.title: Working is the beginning, not the whole horizon.
principles.body: The index brings together communicative effectiveness, accessibility, cultural belonging and formal quality. A clear image that misrepresents, excludes or impoverishes experience still needs work.

app.title: Evaluate a library
app.lead: Three steps. Progress is stored locally in this browser.

library.title: Load the library
library.instruction: Select a JSON file exported from PICTOS.net. The instrument supports raster and SVG images from the current format.
library.samplesBody: All three contain the same 10 phrases produced with different models.
library.empty: No library has been loaded yet.
library.confirmation: Review a sample and confirm that this is the library you want to evaluate.
library.successStatus: Library imported successfully: {count} pictograms ready for evaluation.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: Clarity is the degree to which the pictogram is visually legible and free from ambiguity.

recognizability.name: Recognisability
recognizability.description: Recognisability is how easily a person can identify what the pictogram represents without additional context.

semantic_transparency.name: Semantic transparency
semantic_transparency.description: Semantic transparency is the degree to which the pictogram accurately communicates the meaning of the target phrase.

pragmatic_fit.name: Pragmatic fit
pragmatic_fit.description: Pragmatic fit is the usefulness of the pictogram in real-world AAC communication situations.

cultural_adequacy.name: Cultural adequacy
cultural_adequacy.description: Cultural adequacy is the relevance of the pictogram to the cultural and linguistic context of its intended audience.

cognitive_accessibility.name: Cognitive accessibility
cognitive_accessibility.description: Cognitive accessibility is how easily people with different cognitive abilities can understand and use the pictogram.

1.label: Not functional
1.general: Does not work and requires redesign.

4.label: Good
4.general: Works well, with minor improvements possible.
